schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: THE NEXUS GRAPH-TREE FACE — the generalized verbs any question nexus uses to keep a corpus: deposit_learning, counsel, propose, nexus_table. Every call goes through the librarian's trees and out through db_domain's one gate; the refusals (untraceable, under-floor, wrong-dimension, zero-vector) are all inherited rather than re-implemented.
why: A TOOL WITH THREE USERS OUTSIDE THE CHAIN (the build_inspector's nexus, the orient instrument's nexus, and the chart stages), which is why it berths at the tools rung rather than inside any one of them. AND IT IS THE PROOF OF WHAT 'A TOOL HAS USERS, NOT AN OWNER' MEANS IN CODE: `owner` here is a CALL PARAMETER (nexus_table(nexus, owner=...)), not a property of the module — the tool holds no corpus, it addresses whichever corpus its caller owns. Akien, 2026-08-13: "tools don't have owners they have users."
invoke: imported by the chart-chain machines, cairn/machines/build_inspector/nexus.py, and cairn/tools/orient/nexus.py
entry: Carved out of the chart machine on 2026-08-13 under Akien's ruling — "chart is a skill, it calls a collection of machines. that's the intention." The chart charter it was carved from is the design record of the whole chain and now berths with the skill at cairn/skills/chart/intention+why.json; this file holds only what is THIS component's.
state_and_history: state.json + history.json beside this charter, BORN AT THIS ADDRESS'S FIRST CROSSING. Until a ticket crosses here there is no journal, and that absence is this component's ordinary resting state rather than a missing file — a component that has never sailed has no voyage to record. CORRECTED 2026-08-20 (ticket a-charter-may-not-assert-a-file-that-is-not-there). The corpora themselves are rows behind db_domain's gate, owned by each nexus.
gates: every write goes through the librarian's deposit door and db_domain's single gate; a non-owner write is refused there, not here.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) this tool importing a machine — it did, once: orient's deposit_packet lived here and made the tools rung depend on the machines rung; the 2026-08-13 move handed it back to orient as deposit_orient, matching every sibling stage; (2) a table name derived anywhere but nexus_table; (3) a deposit whose provenance points at a berth that is not on disk.
horizon: re-read when a fourth nexus adopts these verbs, or when the librarian's deposit contract changes.
how_it_learns: it doesn't — it is the instrument its users learn THROUGH. The learning is the corpora its callers own; this module would be identical if every one of them were replaced.
traces_to: Law 1 (a walk to the settled answer instead of re-derivation)
Law 6 (the corpus's owner gates its writes; the tool merely addresses it)
Law 10 (a nexus that cannot be dialled is a claim nobody can check)
owner: CC owns the code and proofs. A tool has users, not an owner — the three nexi above are its users, and each owns its own corpus.
proof: proofs/test_chart_tree.py, sealed by the tester; validations/ beside.
